claims.quote: Type locality: Río Conambo at mouth of River Shione, Río Tigre system, Pastaza State, Ecuador.
The fairy cory, Hoplisoma atropersonatum, long known as Corydoras atropersonatus, is an armoured catfish known only from the Tigre and Nanay drainages in Ecuador and Peru.
